test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

She bakes the cake.

options.text: The cake has baked by her.
The cake is baked by her.
The cake had baked by her.

solution:
The correct answer is **'The cake is baked by her'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice construction involves rearranging the sentence so that the subject receives the action of the verb, rather than performing the action. 
 
• In this case, "**She bakes the cake**" is in active voice, with "**she**" being the subject performing the action of baking the cake.
 
• In the passive voice, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence, and the verb is changed to its past participle form (**usually with the auxiliary verb "to be"**).
 
• In this question **is + v3 **is used in passive voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 3'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1** is incorrect because it uses the present perfect tense ("has baked") instead of the simple present tense ("bakes") and does not correctly form the passive voice.
 
• **Option 2** is incorrect because this option changes the meaning entirely and suggests that the cake will perform the action of baking "her," which is not the intended meaning of the original sentence.
 
• **Option 4** is incorrect because this option uses the past perfect tense ("had baked") instead of the simple present tense ("bakes") and does not correctly form the passive voice.
